facts.text: Director Zachary Weintraub is the youngest son of producer Fred Weintraub, who also produced this film. Dad's résumé: Enter the Dragon with Bruce Lee.
Lance Henriksen was James Cameron's original pick to play The Terminator. Cameron even drew concept art of him in the role before Arnold got it.
Lance Henriksen was illiterate until age 30, when he learned to read by studying movie scripts. Not bad for a guy playing the villain here.
Henriksen and Bill Paxton are the only two actors to face off against a Terminator, an Alien and a Predator.
This was shot in Zagreb, Croatia, as a Croatia-US co-production with Jadran Film.
Isaac Hayes was the first African American composer to win an Oscar for Best Original Song, for the Theme from Shaft.
Isaac Hayes' Chef on South Park was meant to be a one-time gig, but audiences loved him so much he became a regular.
Sherilyn Fenn was once engaged to Johnny Depp. Her name is scrawled across his helmet in Platoon.
David Lynch, who cast Sherilyn Fenn in Twin Peaks and Wild at Heart, called her 'five feet of heaven in a ponytail.'
Sherilyn Fenn's dad Leo managed Alice Cooper for 13 years. Rock and roll runs in the family.
Fred Weintraub once owned the Bitter End in Greenwich Village, where Bob Dylan, Woody Allen and Peter, Paul and Mary played. He also oversaw Woodstock at Warner Bros.
Matthew Porretta (Caleb) was in two Mel Brooks films: Robin Hood: Men in Tights, with his brother Greg, and Dracula: Dead and Loving It.
Henriksen left home at 12 and spent time in an orphanage and a foster home. He didn't start acting until age 30.
Isaac Hayes was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 2002, a year before this movie.
